moments.title: Why AI Agents Can't Actually Pay Your Bills
moments.insight: Most banking apps use simple screen scraping that gets blocked easily, so Softron gives AI agents real access to banks and utilities.

moments.title: The Data Ownership Fight: Whose Info Is It?
moments.insight: Banks claim your personal data as their own property and are now threatening to charge you just to access it via apps like Cash App.

moments.title: Turning ChatGPT Into a Financial Advisor
moments.insight: A Softron-ChatGPT integration revealed a user spends seven times more on fruits and vegetables than her Seattle neighborhood average.

moments.title: Is Sales and Marketing a Dying Career?
moments.insight: The guest argues AI will eliminate sales jobs entirely since buyers will just ask ChatGPT which product is best instead of trusting a salesperson's handshake.

moments.title: Trade Show Booths Are Just Money on Fire
moments.insight: Spending millions on conference booths is really just 'proof of bling' to signal status, not an efficient way to transfer product information.

moments.title: Softron's Endgame: Acquired by a Frontier AI Lab
moments.insight: The founder predicts Softron will be acquired by a major AI model company as they hit a 'data wall' and need proprietary access to real-world data.
